label: prf:categorical-dirac-operator-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of the categorical Dirac operator
html:
The strategy relies on a direct algebraic classification. Take a general affine operator of the form \alpha \nabla + \beta \iota_\xi \nabla and apply the defining categorical constraints; they algebraically force the unique solution \alpha=q^{-1} and \beta=1-q^{-1}.

The formula is a fixed R-linear combination of \nabla and \iota_\xi \nabla. Any morphism \mathcal{D}' that equals this combination with the same coefficients is literally the same morphism, since the underlying data (\nabla, \xi, q) is part of the QOU datum and fixed. Hence \mathcal{D}' = \mathcal{D}_\nabla.
heading: Proof
